newsitem.title: USA: Highwoods offers $100 mln & $110 mln notes.
newsitem.headline: Highwoods offers $100 mln & $110 mln notes.

text.p: Highwoods Properties Inc said on Tuesday its operating subsidiary Highwoods/Forsyth Ltd Partnership had offered $100 million of 6.75 percent notes due on December 1, 2003, and $110 million of seven percent notes due on December 1, 2006.
The company said the $100 million notes were priced at 80 basis points over the current yield for seven-year Treasury notes and were sold at 99.735 percent of par to yield 6.917 percent.
The $110 million notes were priced at 95 basis points over the current yield for 10-year Treasury notes and were sold at 99.73 percent of par to yield 7.134 percent.
Proceeds from the offering will be used to pay revolving loan and secured notes debt and to settle various interest rate swap agreements, the company said.
